spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin when Trend Score exceeds 7, Relative Trend Score exceeds 7, and price closes at a 10-day high, exiting when Trend Score falls below 5.
spec.untestable_reason: Entry and exit depend on proprietary Bitcoin Trend Score and Relative Trend Score that cannot be expressed as mechanical rules.

claimed.other: average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%; ten buy signals

assumptions: NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Bitcoin Trend Score and Bitcoin Relative Trend Score are proprietary scores with no definition in the claim and no matching indicator in the schema.
Entry 10-day high interpreted as close at 10-bar highest high.
Direction interpreted as long from buy signals.
Timeframe 1d and asset BTC chosen from page context, not stated in claim text.
Exit falling below 5 refers to the proprietary Trend Score and is also not expressible.
